items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: So in '40, Duke called me and I thought I was going to be an arranger, see, and he wanted a copyist. I said okay, I'd copy.

ctx.x: Listen -- see, I was in the Apollo Theatre, and the girls -- this was in 1940, and the girls wanted more money, see, and the man wouldn't give them any money, so they quit. And that took me out of a job, see. See, I used to arrange and copy all my music and rehearse it for the band, see, and when the girls quit, I quit with them because I didn't have no job, see?
So in '40, Duke called me and I thought I was going to be an arranger, see, and he wanted a copyist. I said okay, I'd copy.
And that's how I started copying with Duke.
